decision_basis.summary: The implementation is honestly non-authorizing and most isolated numerical primitives are well tested, but the canonical stochastic diagnostic serializer violates accepted Amendment 001 and the per-identity packing API does not enforce the global pre-label eligibility firewall. These are code/contract failures. Separately, all five Gate-2 scientific thresholds fail, so phase-mass training and claims remain dead even if the code defects were repaired.

findings.title: The frozen 1,000-pack erases computed finite diagnostics by conflating score validity with computation
findings.impact: Amendment 001 requires raw finite ACF/score diagnostics where computed and computed/valid masks that distinguish computation from eligibility, including the canonical stochastic rows. The serializer keeps values only where score_valid is true, the stochastic schema has no computed masks, and the ten-case verifier mirrors the same wrong oracle. Candidate-v2 is byte/hash-consistent and its decisions are stable, but its canonical diagnostic content is not compliant with the accepted contract.
findings.required_disposition: Do not overwrite or silently repair the frozen pack. Preserve K5/Gate2 failure. Any prospective correction requires explicit new protocol authority, a schema with computed masks or raw finite serialization, new immutable bytes, and genuinely independent validation.

findings.title: pack_identity can open evaluator labels before the complete count-blind population and nine-component table are frozen
findings.impact: The coverage helper is standalone and proves neither completeness nor a frozen population digest. pack_identity accepts one per-identity eligibility decision and invokes vault_factory for an eligible identity after only local checks and ACL evidence. A future adapter calling this public primitive can therefore read the first label before all identities are counted, checksum-frozen, deduplicated, and shown to preserve all nine components. Gate0 is currently blocked, so this unsafe transition is not CLI-reachable today.
findings.required_disposition: Require a two-phase batch transaction: freeze and hash the exact complete identity population and original component mapping; validate uniqueness, completeness, and all nine nonempty components; then issue a receipt-bound capability required by every vault-open operation.

findings.title: verify_fixture_pack does not bind the canonical receipt to live generator/selector/environment sources
findings.observed_integrity: The current candidate-v2 pack has 23 exact members, aggregate c6dbe56df7b4f7d427ce1f51d5d818ad0e46dcfbf6e1550e0d77116435760196, live generator hash 7af1dac0ce246979d608b3db8e9fcaef9fe18dbfe2a5ecc803616e30919bb4ce, live selector hash 73b31b7d6c58a67efa8542df754971a58926d783258c9776269ec06765dafa0e, and v2 fixture-lock hash c278c77b27467f5928fa37d2fc79580dc58ec5d55cf98eee89f7e69e77d947a0; all independently match.
findings.impact: The current bytes are not substituted, but the Gate1 verifier treats generator_source_sha256 as an arbitrary well-formed digest, parses metadata without validating its fields against live sources, validates the fixture lock separately, and recomputes only ten rows. A future self-consistent pack/receipt can pass without a live source/environment chain.
findings.required_disposition: Make the verifier repository-root-aware; bind the canonical receipt to exact live generator and selector hashes, metadata schema/content, the exact v2 fixture lock and detached receipt, and the external provenance adjudication.

findings.observed_integrity: This round independently checked all 64 NPY members plus metadata, exact schemas, finite floats, member hashes, live source bindings, three selected periods, and aggregate 406fe3934dd307accbd735dd6f2e54890d6de643c7bfe1d05d9f2d1131a8efcf. No numerical discrepancy was found.
findings.impact: The implementation can report selector_unit_fixture_pack=true before any separately bound review artifact exists, because it explicitly accepts candidate_only=true, authoritative=false, fresh_review_required=true, authorizes=[], and CANDIDATE_NON_AUTHORIZING. This provisional code review does not rewrite those authority fields or pass Gate1.
findings.required_disposition: Add a separately immutable review/adjudication receipt input whose hash is bound into Gate1, or keep this check named and treated as candidate-integrity-only rather than a satisfied Gate1 fixture requirement.

findings.title: Gate3 CPU execution does not require Gate0-2 pass receipts before running
findings.impact: The contract allows the CPU smoke only after Gates0-2 pass, but gate3_cpu_sanity_receipt takes no dependency receipts, runs a model/optimizer update, and only afterward records the missing pass chain. The stored receipt is exactly reproducible and honestly BLOCKED; no GPU job or training campaign was launched, but the execution order is not enforced.
findings.required_disposition: Require and hash-verify Gate0, Gate1, and Gate2 PASS receipts before any Gate3 computation. Diagnostic development tests should not be persisted or labeled as an executed Gate3 receipt.

findings.title: Training/evaluation/result production is deliberately unreachable and the WARP snapshot is not committed
findings.impact: The train command can only emit BLOCKED, no end-to-end fresh-step factory or prediction schema exists, and there is no WARP evaluator CLI/vault-reader/prediction-freeze transition. The bootstrap also derives component order by lexicographic sorting rather than consuming a frozen ordered table/hash, which can alter finite seeded draws. Git HEAD 236d4ad235c1cdd15398e7fdeac0d8c5b569570e does not contain the untracked WARP package/config/scripts/tests/artifacts; only the root CLI attachment and CLI tests are tracked modifications.

If a future protocol authorizes continuation despite Gate2, freeze a committed source snapshot, implement the complete feature-only training path, receipt-bound predictions, evaluator-only vault reader, frozen ordered component table, and full witness chain before any result-bearing execution.
